facts.fact: The Electoral Commission of Zambia presented that it uses biometric voter registration kits capturing ten fingerprints and a portrait, adding new voters to an existing register of 7.07 million, with ABIS deduplication.
facts.system: Biometric Voter Registration Kits / register of voters
